items.passage: We expect our revenue to continue to grow by around 10% to 15% in the coming year.

However, in FY'26, we should witness a higher growth rate of at least 20% to 25%, as new orders are expected to be received in FY'25, which will start generating revenue in FY'26, post the initial mobilization phase of 6 to 9 months in the current year.
We expect to maintain our margins of around 14%, which is there.
So on a full year basis, we expect 10% to 15% growth in the top line. And bottom line, I mean, around same percentage we should be able to maintain.
